subject.title: fix: reject invalid channel account selections

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally change explicit invalid channel-account requests from fallback routing to a clear failure for existing upgraded installations?
rationale: The code path is technically coherent, but the PR removes an observable fallback behavior across CLI, agent, Gateway, and conversation delivery, which repository policy treats as an upgrade-sensitive product choice.

options.title: Adopt strict explicit routing
options.body: Confirm that caller-supplied invalid, disabled, or mismatched accounts must fail instead of borrowing another configured account.

options.title: Retain legacy fallback
options.body: Keep fallback routing for existing explicit selections and redesign the change around an opt-in strict mode or a documented migration path.

recommendation.title: Adopt strict explicit routing
recommendation.body: Confirm that caller-supplied invalid, disabled, or mismatched accounts must fail instead of borrowing another configured account.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence ties this contributor most directly to the proposed account-selection boundary, though a stronger current-main history trace was unavailable in this read-only environment.
